summary: Phase 5a shipped (commit 6e206aa) — the in-person handshake, the first buildable slice of Mycelium Layer 3, per MYCELIUM_NETWORK_SPEC.md. A new connections feature: HandshakeModal runs a three-QR co-signed ceremony between two wallets that are physically together — the initiator shows their identity, the responder builds and signs the handshake, the initiator co-signs, the responder takes the final copy. The result is one relationship-kind attestation carrying a verification=in-person leaf (Tier P), held by both wallets and anchored to Bitcoin. The home gains a live People tab — a fourth tab listing connections, with a New-handshake button. The build was grounded first: an Explore agent mapped the QR, co-sign, and relationship-attestation machinery, and the pattern files were read directly before any code was cut. The co-signed design is deliberate — a one-sided scan-and-record would let anyone forge a Tier P record from a copied QR, so both wallets must actively co-sign for the in-person tier to be honest.

why.text: Operator approved the Mycelium spec and said to cut Phase 5a. The handshake choreography and the co-signed-not-scan-and-record decision were surfaced to the operator and blessed before the build. Grounded per the grounding-gate hook — the QR and co-sign machinery were read as they actually are.

outcome.tests_passing: 19/19 across 5 test files. The library-seam gate caught a local helper named leaf colliding with a tapit-attest export — renamed to leafValue. The features-registry gate confirms the new connections manifest is registered. tapit-attest unchanged 82/78/0/4.
outcome.notes: [P-001] connections feature + 3-QR handshake ceremony (commit 6e206aa). [P-002] People tab live in HomeScreen. [P-003] all four gates green. [P-004] bundle-budget caught a Rollup chunk rename — root-caused (the qrcode shared chunk gets renamed when its co-located modules change) and fixed properly by pinning qrcode to its own manualChunk in vite.config.ts; named budgets added for the qrcode and cosigning-helpers chunks. [FEEDBACK->Foreman]: no notes — grounding caught both the leaf collision class and the chunk-rename root cause before they could become silent debt.

uncertainty: Build-verified only. A real handshake is a 3-QR ceremony between two physical devices and cannot be exercised by CI or by the operator on a single phone — the state machine, the QR round-trips, the co-sign and merge are sound in the markup but unproven in the field. The QR scanner needs iOS Safari 17+ (the operator's platform supports it). The operator can see the People tab and walk the modal solo, but a full connection needs a second wallet.
next: Operator field-tests the handshake with two devices / two people. Phase 5b is organizations and membership attestations (single-key organizations first). Then Phase 5c, Nostr transport, for remote links.
